messages:
maya: Heads up — master CI went red on linux-integration after poetry lock regen. Tests failing in ssl_handshake tests. job: https://ci.internal/1234 :frowning:

ci-bot: Job failed — test-linux-integration #1234 — logs attached (linux / ubuntu-2018 image)

alan: I can reproduce locally after pulling latest lockfile. Trace shows ImportError from OpenSSL binding during test setup.

sophia: can you paste the failing stack?

maya: ```
E   ImportError: pyOpenSSL/BoringSSL bindings failed to load
E   File "/workspace/.venv/lib/python3.10/site-packages/ssl/_ssl.py", line 584, in _verify_cert
E     ...
E   tests/integration/test_ssl.py::test_handshake
```

jordan: can we just rerun the job? sometimes infra flaps.

maya: reran — same failure. not a flaky VM.

alan: quick guess: did a transitive bump pull in a new cryptography wheel? I see the merged lock updated cryptography 41.x -> 42.0.0 in the lockfile diff.

nora: yep — lockfile PR #3456 pulled a new requests/urllib3 that caused cryptography to upgrade indirectly.

alan: can someone run a bisect or try repro with the previous lockfile to confirm it's the cryptography bump?

sophia: I can run a quick bisect tomorrow (OOO rest of day). if someone else has cycles, please go ahead.

maya: minimal repro steps I used locally:
```
git checkout <commit-before-lock-regen>
python -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate
poetry install --no-dev
pytest -q tests/integration/test_ssl.py::test_handshake -k linux
```

jordan: quick workaround idea: pin cryptography==41.0.3 in pyproject.toml and regen lock, then rerun CI. If green, confirms transitive pin is culprit.

maya: tried pinning cryptography -> locally green, but CI still fails on ubuntu-2018 runner. looking like a wheel tag / binary compatibility mismatch on that runner image.

nora: thanks — given risk, I'll open a rollback PR for the lockfile + temporary pin on cryptography for master, and mark as emergency.

alan: please include bisect notes and exact failing job link in the PR description. assign to eng-infra for follow-up investigation.

ci-bot: Created issue #612: "ci: investigate cryptography bump causing ssl integration failure" and queued a rollback PR draft (link: https://git.internal/r/rollback-lockfile-3462).

maya: awesome — @sophia please paste bisect logs when you run them tomorrow so we can root-cause. :thumbsup: 

alan: one more note — if rollback is accepted, let's add a changelog line and schedule a follow-up to re-enable the newer cryptography once we validate wheel compatibility. :eyes:

jordan: I can help test different runner images / wheel rebuilds Wed morning.

nora: will merge rollback + temp pin once CI passes on all runners. thanks everyone. :shipit:
